notes: ⚠️ REQUIRES JAVASCRIPT RENDERING (Playwright/Selenium). This site uses IDX (Internet Data Exchange) system that loads all listing data dynamically via JavaScript/AJAX. The static HTML only contains empty containers. Listings appear under #IDX-resultsContainer but content is injected client-side. The page indicates ~500 total results available. Alternative URLs: apartments (https://search.lmmre.com/i/apartments-for-rent), residential (https://search.lmmre.com/idx/featured). This is a commercial real estate broker (not business-for-sale), focusing on retail, commercial/industrial, and investment properties in Connecticut.
